end.parentNote: Saanvi practised building numbers with one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks. They used the number’s ones digit to identify the loose sticks and correctly worked through 12 in the lesson. They sometimes counted the bundle as 1 in the total, and this mix-up was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, use a group of 10 straws plus loose straws and ask, “How many altogether?”
